test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)

question: In a certain code language, 'CHERRY' is coded as '6-16-10-36-36-50', and 'GRAPES' is coded as '14-36-2-32-10-38'. How will 'LITCHI' be coded in that language?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• CHERRY' is coded as '6-16-10-36-36-50'.
 
• 'GRAPES' is coded as '14-36-2-32-10-38'
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9667cdb52f767659c3dfe38ebd76b3f18f126b12c0c2c3f560595a50e78df75f.png] 

**To find: **Code for 'LITCHI'.

**Explanation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c631e5f819066a2c6f7885f5a8b82ce59936587df7cf521f910b9d695e60e8b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00712f3b6f725f4ef0c044bcc49846c34085bd00944e3d5aec8c9658008086d3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b143551ec7833b0e7a88724c756f480ca92ff364ac4b2829c17160325dedb91.png] 

Using the above information, code for LITCHI will be 24-18-40-6-16-18.

 **24-18-40-6-16-18** is the **correct answer .**
